# `csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions`

Break each operand of a long && or || chain onto its own line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `chop_if_long` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public bool Check(int a, int b, int c)
    {
        return a > 0 && b > 0 && c > 0 && a + b > c && a + c > b && b + c > a;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions = chop_if_long`

```ini
csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions = chop_if_long
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
